hypothesis: Residual marginal-learning-value error may be conditioned on which domain is deprived relative to equal allocation rather than which domain receives the added budget. Keep GLOBAL_BASE6 byte-identical and add exactly three training-only scalar mean-residual offsets keyed by the deterministic deficiency domain.

frozen_design.deficiency_domain: largest positive equal-allocation-minus-candidate allocation delta; ties resolve code then structured then technical_prose
frozen_design.offsets: exactly one arithmetic-mean (actual allocation advantage minus GLOBAL_BASE6 predicted advantage) scalar per deficiency domain over the 27 non-equal training cases, frozen before held-out outcomes
frozen_design.evaluation_cases: same 33 R30-excluded unstable-sign held-out cases used by R41

classification_rules.supported: valid and deficiency-conditioned sign-error improvement>=0.10 with MAE ratio<=1.00
classification_rules.mixed: valid, support false, but deficiency-conditioned sign error and MAE are both lower than GLOBAL_BASE6
classification_rules.negative: valid and neither supported nor mixed
classification_rules.invalid: any frozen identity, GLOBAL_BASE6 identity, deficiency-domain rule, three scalar residual offsets, R30 exclusion, held-out ordering, provenance or accounting rule fails
